name: Bonus 5: Ladies Night Out
source:
The three best friends, Samantha, Nadia visit a strip club for a night of booze and debauchery. See what they get up to once the alcohol starts flowing.

[From [url=https://www.azdev.org/download]the official website[/url]]
translation:
薩曼莎、娜迪婭等三個最要好的朋友相約去了脫衣舞俱樂部，打算喝個痛快，放縱一夜。且看酒過幾巡之後，她們會玩出些什麼花樣。
